newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower in all months.

text.p: All months of Tokyo rubber futures closed lower after position adjustment by local investors in the spot June contract, which expires on June 24, pressured down others, traders said.
Prices were 0.4 to 2.1 yen lower, with the benchmark November 1997 down 0.5 yen at 137.2 yen per kg.
Local investors started liquidating long positions in the spot month from the opening and the market fell amid a lack of fresh incentives, traders said.
The spot June had 5,933 lots of open interest as of June 4.
